reviews.snippet: Food is absolutely amazing!! Big shoutout to Ivan for the great service!

C'est l'un des restaurants les plus agréables de Kalkan avec un menu très varié. Le choix des plats est très intéressant. Les produits sont frais. J'ai commandé le saumon, c'était incroyablement bon. J'ai pris un vin blanc sec turc et j'en suis très satisfait. Le personnel est très poli. Ils servent bien tout le monde, quelle que soit l'origine. Ils parlent parfaitement anglais. J'ai pu discuter avec les employés. La vue sur la marina est magnifique. Un excellent choix pour le dîner. L'addition: 1300 TL.
Çok temiz, kaliteli bir restorant. Deniz kenarı  ortam çok güzel. İlgi alaka ve lezzet çok iyi. Şiddetle tavsiye ederim

My wife and I went for a drink here but because of the welcoming chat with Ali we decided to stay for a meal as well. Unfortunately we were the only people there due to the downpour. For starters my wife had the Meze haydari which was delicious and I had the garlic shrimp which were the size of prawns it was a meal in itself. Main I had chicken Tayuk Sis( shish Kebab) and my wife ha an amazing piece of beautiful salmon. The potions were generous to say the least. All washed down with some really good Turkish wine! A treat for us both on our first day back in Kalkan.

烤鱼和通心粉都很好吃，免费赠了我们囊和面包，还有很多酱料和橄榄。
服务的小哥非常给力，我们要点鱼不知道重量的时候亲自把厨师从后厨喊出来给我们称重选鱼，我真的。
菜的分量和品质都很好，通心粉里面鸡肉很多，吃到最后我是吃不下发现鸡肉还剩很多（因为吃了很多面包和馕）
总之冲着小哥服务我觉得必须给5星，更何况食物也没毛病！
Sezon sonu olduğu için etraf sesiz ve sakindi biz balık yemeyi tercih ettik balıklar lezetliydi salata güzeldi ve sın olarak deniz mahsulleri tava gayet güzeldi.

The owners son was our waiter what a lovely person so happy and great to talk to
Worth a visit just to see him
